items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: Yeah, Classy was in the real estate business... he writes one of the biggest hits... Klessy owned it [Triangle Publishing Company].

ctx.x: Well, tell me something about Classy. He was in the business? He was in the real estate business.

Yeah, Classy was in the real estate business. And for some reason or other, he was fooling around the piano and he writes one of the biggest hits. With Sorry, Major Cry. Imagine that, a man that, you know, it hasn't been out playing professionally or anything like that. He comes along and writes, he writes, Sorry, Major Cry, which was a big hit all over the country. Yeah, that was strange. Did he have any relatives who played music? Nothing I know of.
There was Joe Classy used to have a band here.
